scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml stop db
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-traceability.mjs && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs && node scripts/check-config.mjs
scripts.verify:ci: node scripts/check-traceability.mjs && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs --history && node scripts/check-config.mjs
